title: Future Upgrades and Obsolescence
description: Future Upgrades and Obsolescence as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are known or likely future upgrades that affect the installation identified?
Is space or capacity growth allowed where an upgrade is likely?
Are long-life or obsolescence-prone items identified?
Are growth margins (space, weight, power, flow) stated?
Are bought-in items selected with supply life in mind?
Are interfaces designed so that likely upgrades do not need structural change?
Are obsolescence risks of bought-in equipment recorded?
Are growth provisions shown on the released definitions where agreed?
Are alternative sources recorded for single-source items?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
